_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_trusted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_trusted" IN (0, 1)), "qr_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "deposit_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "available_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_units" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "qr_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "billing_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'weekly', "rate_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "late_fee_per_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "due_date_optional" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("due_date_optional" IN (0, 1)), "requires_unit_identity" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("requires_unit_identity" IN (0, 1)), "unit_code_prefix" TEXT NULL, "allows_dynamic_pricing" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("allows_dynamic_pricing" IN (0, 1)), "default_item_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'rental', "metadata" TEXT NULL, "catalog_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("catalog_active" IN (0, 1)), "security_deposit_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rentals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_at" INTEGER NULL, "returned_at" INTEGER NULL, "qr_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "nickname" TEXT NULL, "billing_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'weekly', "rate_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "late_fee_per_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "base_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "late_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "total_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deposit_applied" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deposit_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sell_paid_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sell_discount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "order_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "workflow_status" TEXT NULL, "duration_units" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "replaced_from_rental_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rental_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rental_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "instance_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "short_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LEGACY', "returned_at" INTEGER NULL, "base_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "late_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "deposit_applied" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "billing_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'weekly', "rate_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "late_fee_per_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "fulfillment" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'rent', "return_disposition" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rental_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "rental_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtitle" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reference_code" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rental_notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rental_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rental_item_id" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general', "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "deposit_ledger" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rental_id" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "balance_after" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "money_loans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "principal_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INR', "interest_kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'simple', "rate_bps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "rate_period" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly', "interest_accrual" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'calendar', "capitalization_policy" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'never', "capitalization_cycle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly', "interest_started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "interest_ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "prepayment_allocation" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'interestThenPrincipal', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "closed_at" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "money_loan_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "loan_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entry_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_paise" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customer_subscriptions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tier" TEXT NOT NULL, "starts_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "valid_until" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source_rental_id" TEXT NULL, "source_item_id" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'image/jpeg', "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "caption" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
